about: A5 routing fixture: four of the person's projects, a few earlier messages in each thread (what the centroid is built from), and 40 new messages labelled with the project they belong to (10 each). Written for the accuracy gate in tests/projects-routing.test.ts; the messages avoid the project names on purpose.
